# R03 narrowly scoped typed-render cleanup

Exact parent: BAR-Metal4 `0780bd7c530b0696067b717428b49a416eda556a`. The 17 original files were independently fetched from this fixed ref and checked against their Git blobs. This local staging history is not a publishable descendant of R03; apply the patch to the real pinned parent. The scope was checked against the [38-path typed-render audit](https://github.com/yeojuny/BAR-on-Metal4/blob/74d93c4013eda6f3c01879ffb20e10720c38b8c8/docs/preservation/2026-11-17-r03-structure-audit/TYPED-PATH-INVENTORY.md).

## Checklist
- [x] Screen the known 38 typed paths for independent, contract-preserving duplicate work.
- [x] Implement five strictly Prepare-local decode reuses and two immutable fixed-index checks.
- [x] Compile/link relevant C++ backends, run focused byte/branch/error checks, and apply the patch to a clean copy of all pinned original files.
- [ ] Independent source review of the staged Objective-C++ changes.
- [ ] macOS SDK/Metal full engine build, representative visual checks, and optional clean CPU timing.

## Included
| Change | Exact removed work | Unchanged contract / validation |
|---|---|---|
| WeaponRange | A second uniform decode and dynamic model-row vector after the existing validated decode in the same final Prepare invocation. | Existing Lua/ScreenDrawList void validators remain. Final minimap/PiP-modified state is the input to Prepare. Runtime viewport, image flips, stencil/depth, height/mask resolution, MSAA and actual target checks remain at their original sites. Static, composite and zero-row draws still have no model reads. |
| Sensor31657Circle | A second UBO read and second read of **both** model-position arrays in the same Prepare. | Circle SSBO and instance VBO retain independent byte ranges/owners. Bounds/revisions/source-frame/compiled family, image and viewport checks are unchanged. This is radar/sonar, not SensorLOS. |
| BuildSquare | The second copy of the original UBO values in Prepare. | Minimap distinction, actual height owner, state, viewport, alpha and native height flip remain independent. |
| Commands FX | The second source uniform read in the draw's Prepare loop. | Source sequence and ordering, empty/cull/viewport handling, actual texture owner and flip are unchanged. |
| StartBox | The second source uniform read in the same Prepare. | Polygon/cone/SDF bake definitions, real target and depth/stencil checks, alpha and dynamic sampler/image versions are unchanged. |
| EnergyExplosion | Allocating and building a validation-only vector of 30 or 42 known original indices; repeated synthesis by the owned-vector helper. | Each dynamic UInt16/32 index is still checked in the same order. Original winding differs from Nano. Existing public helper still fully validates and returns a fresh owned UInt16 vector. |
| LuaNano | Allocating and building a validation-only vector of 30 or 42 known original indices. | Both shapes keep their original, distinct winding and actual-slot comparison; all draw/schema/range checks remain. |

For the first five, public `void Validate…(const Draw&)` signatures, capture and recorder callers, and every check's order are preserved: the wrappers call the same full checked path and discard the value. Final Prepare uses its result locally instead of calling its raw readers a second time. No changes to draw types, packet or publication ownership, cross-draw caches, acquired resources, shader, GPU submission order, output settings, fences, lease operations or retirement. The decoded CPU vectors live slightly longer within their own Prepare call and never escape it. These are source-level reductions in redundant work, not measured runtime, GPU time, or FPS.

## Held separate
- **SensorLOS 6→1** adds a draw-local receipt and shared ownership extending beyond one function. Keep the already isolated candidate unchanged; do not fold it into this strict batch.
- **GameDecal indexed geometry**, GroundDecal pages, CUS cached reads, WorldPlan167/ScopedWorldBorrow168 and prior SensorLOS shader work are not reimplemented or changed.
- Repeated payload scans (Shield/Grass/ResourceSpots/UnitEffects/ObjectSpotlight), snapshots, state/context reads, dynamic postprocess/attachment/texture/version/consumer ordering, and renderer-wide helpers remain outside this change. In particular, do not substitute a shared proof for an externally visible dynamic validation.
- Broad state/lifetime refactors or enablement flags are not needed; this patch does not change which draws render.

## Focused verification
The real 7 changed C++ backends were compiled and linked into `TestPrepareLocalDecode.cpp`. Tests compare the exact original reader bytes to the newly returned bytes, ensure invalid source rejection, exercise dynamic/static/empty/composite range modes and unpublished models, and verify the radar VBO and SSBO independently at nonzero storage offset. Energy and Nano tests independently generate both original windings and use each UInt16/32 representation, then corrupt one index and verify unchanged errors. The source-level five-Prepare integration is also checked by verifying old read calls disappeared while the dynamic `Require`/viewport/residency statements stayed in order. No macOS SDK in the cloud; Metal Objective-C++ compilation, rendering and perf were not run.

The focused portable build on a full R03-based checkout is:
```sh
b=engine/rts/Rendering/Backend
g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Iengine/rts -I"$b" \
  engine/tools/metal4-contracts/TestPrepareLocalDecode.cpp \
  "$b"/Native{BuildSquare,Commands,Sensor31657Circle,StartBox,WeaponRange}Data.cpp \
  "$b"/Native{EnergyExplosion,LuaNano}Recorder.cpp "$b"/NativeCUS{Uniform,Published}Data.cpp \
  -Wl,--gc-sections -o /tmp/test-prepare-local && /tmp/test-prepare-local
```
No Mac/HQ, existing GameDecal round, remote branch, or original source was touched.
